_comment: Zaraz starter configuration. Maps detected third-party tags to server-side execution + consent gating. Import via Zaraz dashboard (Manage Zaraz → Settings → Import). Tools that don't require consent run on every pageview; consent-required tools wait for the user's opt-in.

categories.name: Functional
categories.description: Required for core site functionality (payments, security). Cannot be disabled.

categories.name: Analytics
categories.description: Helps us understand how visitors use the site. No personal data is shared with advertisers.

categories.name: Marketing
categories.description: Used to deliver personalized advertising and measure ad performance.

tools.name: Stripe
tools._note: Payment functional tool; loads stripe.js. Required for checkout.

tools.name: GA4
tools._note: Google Analytics 4. Will not fire until user grants 'analytics' consent.

tools.name: Hotjar
tools._note: Session recording — definitely needs consent. Verify your privacy policy lists Hotjar by name.

tools.name: GTM
tools._note: Google Tag Manager fans out to many downstream tags — easier to bypass GTM and configure each tag in Zaraz directly. Listed here only because it's commonly detected.
